p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-up, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens the updated official sources, then reads them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Assistance Service (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for one product and one country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (MAM): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and EU entry duties
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Taxes, International Trade, Country by Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform has not been signalled by a regulator before entrusting money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in your own language: use the translation of your browser, or « Understanding a document » for a document in your own language.
p.espaces.cu_d: Rights, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The ONE WORLD 24/24 cross-border buying and selling guide does not present customs declarations: a licensed customs agent (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ICC, WTO): rights and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): tariffs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: According to the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on ship; after that, risks and costs are of the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. These lists are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_find: Find a carrier or transport company
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the rates for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money by itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Global remittance pricing (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash collection in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash collection, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash pick-up
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash collection
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total received: commissions + exchange rate, a worse than market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: in cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan, or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when they ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer, easy to get started but you are still responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (lists "wholesale/supplier" here or wholesale platforms) and ask for a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting the rights of customers: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrencies.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
